species.definition: LAMMB is a rebellious anthropomorphic sheep: broad low lateral ears, compact rounded muzzle, large wool-heavy head, curled wool and expressive heavy lids. Structure and material changes must preserve these landmarks. This design proposal is grounded in REVIEW references, not an approved Genesis Base.
landmarks: One coherent sheep muzzle and nose axis
Two primary eyes with meaningful eyelids
One low lateral ear pair with intact roots
Continuous recognizable curl silhouette at crown and temples
Short sheep neck and shoulder bust
prohibited: Rabbit ears, rabbit muzzle or generic human skull pasted onto a sheep
Colorado signage and arbitrary location claims
Accessories used as an automatic grail or rarity claim

grails.visualDefinition: A single bounded negative-space neck suspended within a coherent luminous sheep outline. A radial void is visibly tied to the neck silhouette, not an accessory or random hole.
grails.silhouetteTest: Negative-space neck and light ear/wool frame remain identifiable at 64px.
grails.materialTest: A continuous void boundary, material-aware rim and coherent primary eye pair.

grails.visualDefinition: An intentional open graphite cervical lattice with one recursive chartreuse light path. Sheep muzzle and two low ears remain organic and expressive.
grails.silhouetteTest: The geometric neck aperture is distinctive at thumbnail size without extra headwear.
grails.materialTest: Titanium, fiber and embedded light form a deliberate bounded mechanism.

grails.visualDefinition: Swept cooled basalt horns and a single internally lit throat core. Heat is contained away from wool; silhouette matters more than flames.
grails.silhouetteTest: The swept horn and throat shape remains unmistakably sheep at 64px.
grails.materialTest: Cooled basalt shell and internal chartreuse emission have separate surfaces.

grails.visualDefinition: A deliberate transparent neck prism bends one chartreuse beam while preserving a coherent quartz sheep muzzle and intact wool.
grails.silhouetteTest: A single neck prism creates a clear geometric silhouette, not a pile of crystals.
grails.materialTest: Controlled optical thickness and consistent refraction; no random rainbow glitter.

grails.visualDefinition: A woven living bark neck chamber with one embedded seed light, small controlled buds and a heavy-lidded sheep face.
grails.silhouetteTest: A continuous branching neck structure remains legible independently of foliage decoration.
grails.materialTest: Bark, moss, wool and a single seed light have exceptional distinct treatment.

grails.visualDefinition: Two expressive primary sheep eyes and exactly three smaller anatomically integrated orbital eyes. No duplication of the face or muzzle; one intentional array.
grails.silhouetteTest: One integrated orbital arch produces a memorable sheep silhouette at 64px.
grails.materialTest: Coherent organic lids and optical wet surfaces; no accessory-based extravagance.
